verdict_logic.pass_condition: SECC rejects the V2GTP message with invalid ProtocolVersion (0x02) by either closing the TCP connection or not returning any V2G application-layer response within the timeout period
verdict_logic.fail_condition: SECC accepts the invalid V2GTP message and returns a normal V2G application-layer response, indicating it did not enforce the ProtocolVersion=0x01 requirement
verdict_logic.inconc_condition: Test setup fails, TCP connection cannot be established, or an unexpected message is received that does not allow a definitive pass/fail verdict
